# The Simple Data Analysis Library

> Fast DuckDB-powered TypeScript library for tabular, geospatial, vector, AI, Google Sheets, and data visualization workflows on Deno, Node.js, and Bun.

- Package: `@nshiab/simple-data-analysis`
- Version: `6.0.1`
- Includes: `@nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core@2.0.4`

Install with Deno: `deno add jsr:@nshiab/simple-data-analysis`

Install with Node.js: `npm i @nshiab/simple-data-analysis`

Install with Bun: `bun add @nshiab/simple-data-analysis`

## Documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis/main/README.md): Installation, quick start, concepts, and examples.

- [JSR API reference](https://jsr.io/@nshiab/simple-data-analysis/doc): Searchable documentation for the published package.
